name: Feldspar
slug: Feldspar is an Arch realm of Atlas centered on knowledge, magic, science, alchemy, and the exploration of arcane and scientific understanding.
description: Feldspar is one of the Arch realms of Atlas, characterized by a focus on knowledge, magic, science, alchemy, and experimentation. It is associated with the pursuit and exploration of arcane and scientific understanding.

log.summary: Feldspar was selected by Ord as his assigned Arch realm during the session. Ord received Feldspar’s keystone and became its Gatekeeper, establishing his responsibility for the realm. Feldspar was described as an inner realm centered on knowledge, magic, science, alchemy, and experimentation.
notes: Feldspar is an inner realm focused on knowledge, magic, science, alchemy, and experimentation.
Ord receives its keystone and becomes its Gatekeeper.
